criteria: The executor identifies valueOf(source.name()) between independently evolving sales and billing contexts as a fragile mapping.
It replaces only StatusAdapter's name-based conversion with an exhaustive explicit mapping owned by the adapter.
It preserves the public StatusAdapter API, both context enums, public tests, and behavior for every current value.
It leaves GeneratedParityMapper unchanged because its generated types share an explicitly documented authoritative schema and parity check.
It does not invent a domain port, Spring component, new public contract, or topology-focused test.
